config.description: Mnemoverse API key (starts with mk_live_), for this local package only: the hosted server https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp signs in with OAuth and takes no key. Optional to install and inspect — the server starts and lists its tools without a key; every actual tool call requires one. Get one free in ~30s at https://console.mnemoverse.com
